text_block_list.text:
I heard from Transcend that a group of Umamusume
with shared hobbies are shooting an independent
short film together.

They said it was okay to observe the photoshoot,
so I decided to go check it out, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trai-cha~n.
Over here, over here. Filming's already started~.

Where Transcend was looking,
near the dorm entrance,
some Umamusume were putting on an act.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"We're all amateurs, so we're just feeling our way through.
They asked me for some advice, but..."

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Your parents are movie directors, right?
Please, give me some advice!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Advice, huh...? I read the script, though,
and it looked like it was super fun to write,
plus it had great momentum, so I really liked it~

text_block_list.name: Lead Actress Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"But, well... surely there's something off, right?
I want you to point out stuff like that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Are you publishing this somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-No, it's nothing that grand!
It's just a keepsake with some hobby friends...
I have no intention of submitting it anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Lead Actress Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm a total amateur, after all. But it looked so fun that I got all excited...
and thought I'd give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Then all the more reason.
If I were to offer some advice—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Forward without hesitation!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's a hobby, after all,
so you should just enjoy it to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Besides, when you've got momentum,
it strangely pulls everyone around you along with it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is their movie.
It's meant for them to enjoy themselves, right?
I'm just lucky to get some of the leftovers here, so—

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wouldn't it be better to act like
you're running away sadly there?
Considering all the pain you went through.

text_block_list.name: Lead Actress Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why I think you should dare to laugh. Laugh, and slowly walk away. It carries so much more weight that way—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Wanna see?

"In this scene, an Umamusume who gave up on her dream
is leaving the dormitory.
She's slated to get back on her feet later, but..."

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...No.
Um, Transcend-san, Trainer-san.
What do the two of you think?

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Running away in tears, versus
walking away with a smile... which one
do you think fits the scene better?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm... If I give my opinion, I feel like it'll just be biased toward my own tastes... So I'm leaving it to you, Trainer!

Since I was tasked with it, I'll think about it.
The scene where they give up on their dream.
It really breaks my heart, but...
choice_data_list: How about taking two different patterns?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: A combo move, huh? ...That might not be bad?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Like a self-deprecating smile, and running off out of frustration? Something like that?"

text_block_list.name: Lead Actress Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, true. If I just walk, my mood
might get too heavy, making it harder to imagine bouncing back...

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Smiling through held-back tears lets you feel the pain you're enduring.
...Hmm, that might actually work!

The photoshoot proceeded smoothly after that.
Seeing that they got shots they were satisfied with
brought a smile to my face as well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Every time you look back at it, it's sure to bring a smile to your face again."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...A hobby is meant to be enjoyed, after all.

I gave a quiet nod to Transcend,
who was smiling with satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ooh. As long as you're not making it public, there's no harm in having all kinds of variations.

text_block_list.name: Director Umamusume
text_block_list.text: T-True...!

text_block_list.name: Lead Actress Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah. In that case, why don't we try
shooting other patterns for a different scene!?
Like, for example, the rooftop scene—

Ideas flew back and forth one after another,
accompanied by the cheerful sound of lively voices.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Running through this many patterns
would exhaust anyone normally, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Imagining what I want to do.
...I just can't stop getting excited.

It was just a casual discussion without
anything concrete yet, but that time
felt so thoroughly enjoyable.
